title: LncRNA SLNCR phenocopies the E2F1 DNA binding site to promote melanoma progression.
authors: Shah, Kushani; Anastasakou, Eleni; Sejour, Leinal; Wang, Yufei; Wert-Lamas, Leon; Rauchet, Christopher; Studer, Sabine; Goller, Simon; Distel, Robert J; Marasco, Wayne; Perera, Lalith; Vlachos, Ioannis S; Novina, Carl D
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟和生化实验研究lncRNA SLNCR模拟E2F1 DNA结合位点与E2F1的互作机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但聚焦转录因子结合域与核酸互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The long non-coding RNA SLNCR and the transcription factor E2F1 are known melanoma oncogenes. We show that SLNCR binds to E2F1 to promote the proliferation, invasion, and migration of melanoma cells from the bloodstream into the lungs. Blocking SLNCR-E2F1 complex formation without reducing the levels of either SLNCR or E2F1 prevents lung extravasation in mice. A 60-nt fragment of SLNCR contains two RNA analogs of the E2F1 DNA binding site (BS) in opposite orientations and can form a hairpin RNA that phenocopies the E2F1 DNA BS. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and biochemical experiments indicate that this fragment of SLNCR binds to the E2F1 DNA-binding domain more effectively than the E2F1 DNA BS. MD simulations predict higher affinity for DNA-E2F1 complex formation but faster kinetics and a greater number of RNA-amino acid contacts for the RNA-E2F1 complex, suggesting that RNA binding to E2F1 is more kinetically favorable.
abstract_zh: 长链非编码RNA SLNCR和转录因子E2F1是已知的黑色素瘤癌基因。我们证明SLNCR与E2F1结合，促进黑色素瘤细胞从血液中增殖、侵袭和迁移至肺部。在不降低SLNCR或E2F1水平的情况下阻断SLNCR-E2F1复合物形成，可阻止小鼠体内的肺外渗。SLNCR的一个60-核苷酸片段包含两个方向相反的E2F1 DNA结合位点（BS）的RNA类似物，并能形成一种模拟E2F1 DNA BS的发夹RNA。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和生化实验表明，SLNCR的这一片段与E2F1 DNA结合域的结合效率高于E2F1 DNA BS。MD模拟预测DNA-E2F1复合物形成具有更高亲和力，但RNA-E2F1复合物具有更快的动力学和更多的RNA-氨基酸接触，提示RNA与E2F1的结合在动力学上更为有利。
